name: Pulp

whyMatters.en: Sheffield band formed in 1978. After a long underground period, Different Class (1995) put Jarvis Cocker’s class-satire lyrics and glam-tinged arrangements on UK charts alongside Oasis and Blur.
whyMatters.zh: 谢菲尔德乐队，1978 年成立。长期地下活动后，《Different Class》（1995）把 Jarvis Cocker 的阶级讽刺歌词与偏 glam 编曲送上英国榜，与 Oasis、Blur 同期。

lyricQuotes: I wanna live with common people like you
Oh it's a miracle / Let it happen but not to me

shortBio.en: Jarvis Cocker Sheffield Britpop. Common People is the key class-satire single; Different Class is the chart document.
shortBio.zh: Jarvis Cocker 的谢菲尔德 Britpop。《Common People》是关键阶级讽刺单曲；《Different Class》是榜单文献。

body.en:
Pulp formed in Sheffield in 1978. Commercial peak arrived in the mid-1990s after His ’n’ Hers (1994). Jarvis Cocker’s spoken-sung delivery, Candida Doyle’s keyboards, Russell Senior’s violin/guitar, and Steve Mackey’s bass define the peak sound.

Different Class (1995) includes Common People, Disco 2000, and Mis-Shapes—observational lyrics with glam keyboard lifts. Island Records released the album; it reached UK #1.
body.zh:
Pulp 于 1978 年在谢菲尔德成立。商业高峰在《His ’n’ Hers》（1994）之后的 1990 年代中期。Jarvis Cocker 的说唱式演唱、Candida Doyle 的键盘、Russell Senior 的小提琴/吉他与 Steve Mackey 的贝斯定型巅峰声音。

《Different Class》（1995）含《Common People》、《Disco 2000》与《Mis-Shapes》——观察式歌词配 glam 键盘抬升。由 Island Records 发行，登上英国榜冠军。

note.en: His ’n’ Hers–era single; spoken narrative over keyboard swell.
note.zh: 《His ’n’ Hers》时期单曲；键盘铺底下的口语叙事。

note.en: Verse reportage into chant chorus; class-tourism lyric on Different Class; UK Top 2.
note.zh: 主歌报道推进到口号副歌；《Different Class》上的阶级观光歌词；英国榜前 2。

note.en: Keyboard-led mid-tempo single; lyric name-checks Deborah.
note.zh: 键盘主导的中速单曲；歌词点名 Deborah。

body.en:
Common People (1995) moves from verse reportage to a chant chorus. The lyric treats class tourism as a pop story with named detail.

Different Class sits on UK charts beside Oasis and Blur as Sheffield’s observational Britpop document.
body.zh:
《Common People》（1995）从主歌报道推进到口号副歌。歌词把阶级观光写成带具体细节的流行叙事。

《Different Class》与 Oasis、Blur 同期占据英国榜，是谢菲尔德观察式 Britpop 文献。

title.zh: Senior 时期到巅峰五人组

body.en:
Russell Senior adds violin and angular guitar through Different Class; he exits in 1997 before This Is Hardcore. Doyle’s keyboards and Mackey’s bass stay the harmonic bed.

Nick Banks (drums from 1991) completes the peak five-piece with Mark Webber on guitar.
body.zh:
Russell Senior 在《Different Class》前加入小提琴与棱角吉他；1997 年《This Is Hardcore》前离队。Doyle 的键盘与 Mackey 的贝斯仍是和声底。

Nick Banks（1991 年起鼓）与吉他手 Mark Webber 一起完成巅峰五人组。

alt.en: Jarvis Cocker of Pulp at Sziget Festival, 10 August 2011
alt.zh: Pulp 的 Jarvis Cocker，Sziget，2011 年 8 月 10 日

title.en: Observational lyric into later UK indie
title.zh: 观察式歌词进入后来英国 indie

body.en:
Pulp’s writing habits—character names, social detail, spoken verses—appear in later Sheffield and UK indie. Arctic Monkeys are often linked to that continuity.

Glam keyboards and satire remain identifiable features of the peak records.
body.zh:
Pulp 的写歌习惯——角色名、社会细节、口语主歌——出现在后来谢菲尔德与英国 indie 中。Arctic Monkeys 常被关联到这条延续线。

Glam 键盘与讽刺仍是巅峰专辑的可辨特征。
